newsitem.title: UK: UK August bank mortgage lending up 632 mln stg - BBA.
newsitem.headline: UK August bank mortgage lending up 632 mln stg - BBA.

text.p: Net mortgage lending by major British banks rose a seasonally adjusted 632 million stg in August after a July rise of 612 million, the British Bankers' Association (BBA) said.
Gross mortgage lending (unadjusted) totalled 2.752 billion stg compared with 2.607 billion in July.
The number of new approvals fell to 38,156 in August from 38,253 the previous month, while their value fell to 2.166 billion stg from 2.213 billion.
The BBA said comparisons with movements a year ago were not meaningful because of the departure of National & Provincial to the banking sector and the inclusion of Cheltenham & Gloucester.

"Seasonally adjusted mortgage lending overall in August was probably close to the buoyant May figure, though approvals data appear to be weaker than last month," BBA director-general Tim Sweeney said.
